parsed.note_claim: TPUSA has announced an "All American Halftime Show" for Feb. 8, 2026, to run opposite the NFL show, but has not yet announced performers or details.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: run opposite the NFL's Super Bowl LX halftime show at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, on Feb. 8 and will be called The All American Halftime Show.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the show's name, date, and opposition to the NFL halftime show, and states performers and details are coming soon.
